messages.subject: isolating fileinput loading
parts:
Hello

I  have written a Shiny R program that will read the CSV file and does some computation and shows the computed results as plot and numeric value.  The computation is
done only when  action button is pressed.  

The problem I have is :  When I select the file first time, it gets loaded and on pressing the action button, I see the results.
But when I select second file, the file gets loaded and the result also shows up without action button.  

I looked at various threads and tried to isolate this but not able to figure out. This is my first Shiny app.. Appreciate if you could help provide some inputs on how I can make computations and display only when action button is pressed.. 

Code is attached..

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: isolating fileinput loading
parts:
Use this code instead of your observer:

observeEvent(input$predict, {
  rv$data <- predictfe()
})

I definitely recommend watching the "Effective Reactive Programming" videos here if you haven't already:
https://www.rstudio.com/resources/webinars/shiny-developer-conference/
